title: Trump's 'Alligator Alcatraz' detention center closes after a year of controversy
summary: Florida's controversial "Alligator Alcatraz" immigration detention centre, a symbol of US President Donald Trump's deportation drive, has closed after operating for less than a year, officials said on Thursday.
